description: Fugas de agua potable en la red provincial is a dataset listed in Diputació de Castelló open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. This dataset is linked to the following visualization: Visualization - Fugas de agua potable en la red provincial Fugas de agua en la red de abastecimiento de agua potable. Datos facilitados por el Servicio de Inspección de Redes de la Diputación de Castellón. Coverage: Province of Castellón. The portal files it under Environment, Urban planning and infrastructures. Its keywords are aguas, calidad ambiental, geolocalizado, provincia de Castellón. The portal shows 1,775 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datosabiertos-dipcas-es-portal.
